## TriggerMenu.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `triggers` :: Trigger definitions mapping characters (`@`, `/`, `#`) to option lists.
- `value` :: Text input content; bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever text changes or a trigger insertion completes.
- `onSelect` :: Called when an item is chosen from the trigger menu.
- `multiline` :: Render a multi-line `<textarea>` rather than a single-line `<input>`.
- `rows` :: Visible row count when `multiline` is true.
- `placeholder` :: Input placeholder text.
- `size` :: Control height and text scale on the shared size ladder.
- `shape` :: Corner family of the composer frame, `rect` through `round`; it defaults to `modern`.
- `surface` :: The surface of the suggestion popup.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the message shown when nothing matches.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the trigger label and the item descriptions.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the trigger label, the item icons and the item descriptions.
- `disabled` :: Disable editing and trigger popups.

## trigger-menu.ts

### `interface TriggerConfig`

The input a trigger menu watches, and which characters open it.

- `triggers` :: Characters that open the menu, e.g. `['@', '/']`.
- `trigger` :: The single trigger character for a menu that only watches one.
- `items` :: The suggestion list shown while the menu is open.
- `label` :: The menu's accessible label.

### `interface TriggerMenuItem`

One row of the suggestion popup.

- `insertText` :: What replaces the trigger + query when the item is picked; `value` when omitted.

### `interface ActiveTriggerMatch`

A trigger word found immediately before the caret.

- `start` :: Index of the trigger character in the text.
- `query` :: What the user has typed after it.

### `function detectTrigger`

Detects an active trigger word immediately preceding `caret` with no inner whitespace.
